# Summary

Address three actual P2 findings from #4851 and this PR. Raw CRLF checkout bytes could disagree with the capability catalogue; lexical output paths could follow aliases into the checkout; adding LF attributes alone did not refresh unchanged files in an existing checkout.

- Pin the complete byte-hashed closure and generated identities to LF, preserving the opaque manuscript rules.
- Resolve the real output path and nearest existing ancestor, preflight every finite destination before writes, and preserve the original sixteen campaign calls and immediate partial-failure evidence.
- Provide an explicit, version-bound, stdlib-only checkout upgrade. Default dry-run writes nothing. Apply authenticates all 49 fixed bodies, refuses private edits or mixed endings before writes, retains all originals in an external private backup, and replaces only stale CRLF files with their pinned LF bytes. It never changes the Git index/configuration or runs a generator automatically.
- Cover actual parent-to-target Git upgrades, refusal and retained-backup behavior, alongside the earlier path and fresh-checkout regressions.

Public head `bc281cc35faf6aeb9d53910031663e15d1b6f390`, tree `d36301c17c4c53297aaa4d4c5cbf2c7b7387a775`, sole parent `1bac5ac9a5b51c4a0277e3f5bfd08c80cf6a6d3e`. All four new delta bodies were read back exactly; the complete public tree has 4,405 entries / 3,773 files / 193,022,773 raw bytes. The unsigned public commit has the same complete tree as local `be7485eb233aed8dd5d161627af0a4c3b9e5ddbb`; their histories are distinct. The combined PR changes seven paths from main87.

All 52 paper files, all 41 runtime inputs/sourceHash `644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2`, generated pages/catalogues/workers, 32 workflows/action pins, 80% coverage and functional deadlines remain exact. The upgrade helper and regression fixture are outside the runtime closure. The generator algorithm is unchanged.

# Validation

- Author: ten selected Python tests PASS, Black/Ruff/Flake8 PASS. The actual upgrade reproduced 47 stale files and 40 catalogue mismatches, then repaired all 49 bodies with original backups, modes, staged content, index, configuration and paper bytes preserved.
- Independent: the ordinary upgrade and private-edit refusal passed; seven new regressions PASS. All 633 trees were reconstructed from every raw/index/HEAD file; the exact four-path child delta and all protected identities match. Final scoped review SHA256 `8f5e5f783bc242c80f7412a6fbca17feb54ab678eb2d18c01e191b8a0c4b1092`; full independent manifest `3e5e13ecdf3f522b5c46a95bf5803df668b74b6eba2d8fd15f346c08102c00fe`. Author report `5f81471710b5c8f8021386f67ef6fdebdff1f5feb8406b0918b65c604f069995`.
- Earlier unchanged JavaScript retains its 25-case Node22.17.1 and Node24.21.0 runs; earlier portable LF/generation tests and independent sixteen-record campaign comparison remain source-scoped evidence.
- The initial upgrade test's clean-Git-status expectation failed after the byte repair; that log remains. The final contract checks raw bytes and unchanged index, with an empty ordinary diff. No clean-status/index-refresh, concurrent-writer, rollback or durability guarantee is claimed.
- Native Windows, full environment/pre-commit/coverage/browser/native campaigns and actual-main release qualification remain separate. Local strict mypy and full pip/NumPy/pandas environment preflight were unavailable/refused; no packages were installed.
